actions.description: Capture a single image from a named camera with a declared resolution and exposure and return an image artifact reference.

inputs.description: Select one declared image source; each capture is independent.
inputs.name: camera

actions.name: capture

facts.text: The node initializes as igibson_sim and loads the igibson-ros package configuration.
The node constructs a headless iGibsonEnv with action_timestep 1/30 and calls reset.
The node creates an Image publisher on the absolute topic /gibson_ros/camera/rgb/image with queue size 10.
The run loop converts the iGibson rgb observation to uint8 and creates the ROS image with cv2_to_imgmsg using encoding rgb8.
The image header stamp is rospy.Time.now and the image frame_id is camera_depth_optical_frame.
turtlebot_rgbd.yaml sets image_width and image_height to 256 and vertical_fov to 90.
The configured sensor output list includes rgb, depth and scan.
The same configuration bounds depth with depth_low 0.8 and depth_high 3.5.
The node publishes depth images on /gibson_ros/camera/depth/image and /gibson_ros/camera/depth/image_raw.
The depth message is created from a float32 depth array with encoding passthrough.
The node publishes a PointCloud2 lidar cloud on the absolute topic /gibson_ros/lidar/points.
The node subscribes to the absolute topic /mobile_base/commands/velocity with a Twist callback and to /reset_pose with a PoseStamped callback.
cmd_callback stores data.linear.x in cmdx and the negated data.angular.z in cmdy.
tp_robot_callback calls reset_new_pose with the message position and orientation and records the teleport time.
The main loop calls iGibsonEnv.step with [cmdx, cmdy] until ROS shuts down.
The launch starts the igibson-ros turtlebot_rgbd.py node and remaps /mobile_base/commands/velocity to /cmd_vel.
The README states that the repository provides instructions and code to set up an iGibson environment with a ROS interface and ROS navigation stack.
SimNode.__init__ of turtlebot_rgbd.py takes no argument besides self.
The main block of turtlebot_rgbd.py parses --enable_left_right_cams with argparse and then calls SimNode(args) and node.run(args).
The run loop has no rate limiter: each pass steps iGibsonEnv once and publishes one image.
The README runs the simulation with roslaunch turtlebot_custom_nav.launch.
turtlebot_custom_nav.launch starts turtlebot_rgbd.py as the node turtlebot_gibson_sim.
turtlebot_env.py creates the same Image publisher on /gibson_ros/camera/rgb/image.
turtlebot_env.py converts the rgb observation with cv2_to_imgmsg using encoding rgb8.
The main block of turtlebot_env.py constructs SimNode() and calls node.run() without arguments.

determinism.notes: Event-driven canned image replies with no iGibson render, physics step, sensor noise or wall-clock pacing

fidelity.engine: analytic:ROS-free canned Image packets (no iGibson renderer or physics)
gaps: the fake is a ROS-free rosbridge contract stand-in: it answers the declared sensor_msgs/Image subscription and runs no iGibson environment, renderer, physics step, roslaunch or ROS graph
the fake returns a 2x2 rgb8 placeholder frame, not the configured 256x256 image (igibson-ros/turtlebot_rgbd.yaml:61-62); the fake's dimensions are test data
the fake's header seq, stamp and frame id are placeholders; a real capture carries the publisher's rospy.Time.now stamp and camera_depth_optical_frame (igibson-ros/turtlebot_rgbd.py:94-100)
the depth Image (float passthrough), raw depth Image, PointCloud2 lidar cloud, /odom, /ground_truth_odom, CameraInfo and TF are NOT COVERED

the /mobile_base/commands/velocity motion command and /reset_pose teleport are NOT COVERED; the clone has no acknowledged ROS stop service or action, so this package does not claim motion control or simulator stepping

the fake does not model the node's run loop (one image per iGibsonEnv step of action_timestep 1/30, with no rate limiter, igibson-ros/turtlebot_rgbd.py:49-51, 77-221), message drops, transport fragmentation or image encoding errors that a live deployment may produce

as pinned, turtlebot_rgbd.py cannot start: its main block calls SimNode(args) while SimNode.__init__ takes only self (igibson-ros/turtlebot_rgbd.py:25, 247), and every launch file of the clone starts that script; until the operator repairs it or runs turtlebot_env.py (same topic and encoding, igibson-ros/turtlebot_env.py:33, 62, 187-190), the topic stays silent and every live capture fails with a timeout
the package does not render, simulate or validate iGibson physics; no live ROS graph, iGibson process, camera or hardware run was performed

safe_state.description: The selected device is the simulated RGB camera stream; this package binds no actuator, motion command, stop, pause, reset or stepping endpoint. The upstream /mobile_base/commands/velocity Twist input, /reset_pose teleport input, depth images, PointCloud2, odometry and CameraInfo are not exposed. The pinned clone declares no acknowledged ROS stop service or action for the simulator, so a software e-stop latches and refuses new captures; it does not stop iGibson or the upstream node.
